typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ClaimId as string,
		Member_First_Name as string,
		Member_Last_Name as string,
		Member_Middle_Name as string,
		Member_PolicyID as string,
		ErrorCode as string,
		ErrorMessage as string,
		MemberDetails_864 as string,
		ReceiptDate_864 as string,
		Gs_Control_Date as string,
		FileName_864 as string,
		FileName_277CA as string,
		Claim_Submitted_837 as string,
		SOURCE_SYSTEM as string,
		CLAIM_TYPE as string,
		Claim_Loaded_X12 as string,
		MARKET_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED  DECLARE @BEGINDT VARCHAR(10) = ? , @ENDDT VARCHAR(10) = ?   SELECT DISTINCT 	  A2A.CLCL_ID AS [Claim_Submitted_837] 	  ,A2A.SOURCE_SYSTEM 	  ,A2A.CLAIM_TYPE 	  ,CASE WHEN A2A.GRGR_CK = 89 THEN \'WNY\' ELSE LEFT(GRGR.GRGR_ID, 2) END AS MARKET_NAME 	  ,X12.CLCL_ID AS [Claim_Loaded_X12]       ,RPT.[ClaimId]       ,RPT.[Member_First_Name]       ,RPT.[Member_Last_Name]       ,RPT.[Member_Middle_Name]       ,RPT.[Member_PolicyID]       ,RPT.[ErrorCode]       ,RPT.[ErrorMessage]       ,RPT.[MemberDetails_864]       ,RPT.[ReceiptDate_864]       ,RPT.[Gs_Control_Date]       ,RPT.[FileName_864]       ,RPT.[FileName_277CA]  FROM /*(SELECT CLCL_ID,SOURCE_SYSTEM,CLAIM_TYPE,GRGR_CK, RANK() OVER(ORDER BY RUNTIMESTAMP) RNK FROM DX_EDI.DBO.A2AMonthlyClaimsImportHistory  WHERE RUNDATE >= @BEGINDT AND RUNDATE <= @ENDDT) A2A*/	 (SELECT CLCL_ID,SOURCE_SYSTEM,CLAIM_TYPE,GRGR_CK FROM DX_EDI.DBO.A2AMonthlyClaimsImport   		WHERE GRGR_CK IN (SELECT GRGR_CK FROM DX_EDI.DBO.EDI_A2A_SelectionCriteria WHERE codetype = \'MarketCode\' and value2 >= @BEGINDT and value2 <= @ENDDT) 		) A2A INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR (NOLOCK) ON A2A.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK LEFT JOIN dx_edi.dbo.Edi_CCERT_Claim_Mapping X12 ON  X12.CLCL_ID = A2A.CLCL_ID AND Gs_Control_Date_837 >= @BEGINDT LEFT JOIN ( SELECT         [ClaimId]       ,[Member_First_Name]       ,[Member_Last_Name]       ,[Member_Middle_Name]       ,[Member_PolicyID]       ,[ErrorCode]       ,[ErrorMessage]       ,[MemberDetails_864]       ,[ReceiptDate_864]       ,[Gs_Control_Date]       ,[FileName_864]       ,[FileName_277CA]  FROM [DX_EDI].[dbo].[A2A_277CA_864_ERROR_REPORT]    WHERE ReceiptDate_864 >= @BEGINDT 		) RPT   ON RPT.[ClaimId] = A2A.CLCL_ID ORDER BY [ClaimId] DESC, A2A.CLCL_ID DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCA2A277CA864ERRORREPORT
OLESRCA2A277CA864ERRORREPORT derive(ErrorCode_out = ltrim(toString(ErrorCode),' '),
		ErrorMessage_out = ltrim(toString(ErrorMessage),' ')) ~> DERTRIM
DERTRIM derive({Copy of ClaimId} = toString(ClaimId),
		{Copy of FileName_277CA} = toString(FileName_277CA),
		{Copy of CLAIM_TYPE} = toString(CLAIM_TYPE),
		{Copy of Member_PolicyID} = toString(Member_PolicyID),
		{Copy of Claim_Submitted_837} = toString(Claim_Submitted_837),
		{Copy of SOURCE_SYSTEM} = toString(SOURCE_SYSTEM),
		{Copy of Member_Last_Name} = toString(Member_Last_Name),
		{Copy of MemberDetails_864} = toString(MemberDetails_864),
		{Copy of Gs_Control_Date} = toString(Gs_Control_Date),
		{Copy of Member_Middle_Name} = toString(Member_Middle_Name),
		{Copy of Claim_Loaded_X12} = toString(Claim_Loaded_X12),
		{Copy of Member_First_Name} = toString(Member_First_Name),
		{Copy of FileName_864} = toString(FileName_864),
		{Copy of ReceiptDate_864} = toString(ReceiptDate_864),
		{Copy of MARKET_NAME} = toString(MARKET_NAME)) ~> DCNVUnicodeConv
DCNVUnicodeConv sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> EXDSTA2A277CA864ERRORREPORT
